reason: Claude streaming captures the application's Chinese or English language hint at recording start and retains it during same-source recovery; an English-only default delays Chinese previews until stop. All supported subscription dictation sources use native continuous PCM transport and incremental transcript events through the shared streaming session, including Claude, Codex and WorkBuddy. Realtime admission rejects unavailable native routes instead of silently starting file segments. File transcription remains an explicit compatibility choice or an announced same-source recovery bound to the original login. TRAE CN adds an independent subscription-backed PCM transcription and streaming dictation source; native refinement and duplex voice remain separate. Recognition provider selection belongs in Voice Input settings for both dictation modes, alongside personalization and a correction dictionary. Refinement and language detection are automatic, with no separate refinement, recognition-language or memory-list controls. Both modes honor the saved provider, with explicit errors instead of automatic substitution. Real-time capture supports signed WebSocket recognition routes, revisable interim snapshots and same-source recovery bound to the original credential. Voice conversation retains its independent source preference. Live dictation accumulates completed utterances and revises only the active utterance so stopping preserves every sentence. End-of-audio acknowledgment is separate from the authoritative whole-recording result, which is inserted and persisted exactly once. Supported realtime sources configure session-native refinement before the first audio frame and publish its complete result without a second text-model request. A short latency budget never discards a pending refinement result; recording duration freezes at stop. The settings menu retires the custom transcription offer: system recognition and signed-in provider sources remain selectable, an absent preference on a device without system recognition stays unselected, and a saved custom selection keeps working as a compatibility file-transcription route until the user replaces it.

initialLoad.preferences: local settings without waiting for capabilities
initialLoad.capabilities: background refresh with section-level failure and retry
initialLoad.dictionary: independent request with section-level loading and retry
initialLoad.absentSource: unselected until system availability is known; never persist a guessed default
initialLoad.lateCapabilityResult: update capabilities without replacing local preferences

textRefinementRouting.preference: current model_tiers:global.low read for each request
textRefinementRouting.unset: follow the dictating chat main model; standalone dictation uses its remembered default
textRefinementRouting.sources: selected subscription or custom source through the engine provider resolver
textRefinementRouting.legacySourceRows: migration evidence only; never a live voice model preference
textRefinementRouting.updates: next request captures the new target; in-flight work retains its original model and cancellation owner

voicePreferences.refinementCompletion: wait for a complete result; a delayed backup races complete refinement without committing raw text or cancelling the pending primary

personalization.disabled: generic refinement and dictionary corrections remain active

dictionary.edit: single term; preserve id and source

experience.selection: use the saved voice.input.source in both modes; never substitute another provider; an absent preference retains the platform default
experience.unavailable: show recovery guidance; file transcription requires an explicit compatibility choice

streamingDictation.acknowledgment: audio and end requests require ok=true; absent or rejected acknowledgments fail capture explicitly
streamingDictation.captureStart: immediate capture with a bounded FIFO while the remote session connects

languageHint.selection: capture current application language at start: zh for Chinese, en for English
languageHint.recovery: retain the captured hint even if application language changes during recording
languageHint.otherSources: preserve native language detection without a hint

streamingDictation.partial: replaceable full text snapshot, including corrections to existing words
streamingDictation.assembly: completed utterances accumulate in arrival order; interim revisions replace only the current utterance, including repeated sentences
streamingDictation.completion: the complete recording transcript supersedes provisional text without discarding completed utterances; a supported interim tail is appended once

publication.previews: display only; never composer insertion, refinement or history
publication.stop: flush capture tail and acknowledge end-of-audio; wait for the whole-recording result
publication.final: refine the complete raw transcript, then insert and persist once; a final result may revise earlier preview words
publication.lateEvents: ignore preview and terminal events after finalization or cancellation

streamingDictation.refinement: configure bounded dictionary, enabled personalization and conversation context at recording start; consume a matching native complete result directly; when native refinement is unavailable or slow, use complete host refinement

nativeRefinement.recognizedEvent: whole-recording raw text after audio drains; internal backup input only, never a final insertion
nativeRefinement.resultScope: whole recording; replace rather than append
nativeRefinement.hostBypass: refinementComplete=true even when the service did not need to change any words

backup.winner: first complete refinement only; reject truncated or raw fallback responses; cancel and fence the losing route

streamingDictation.recovery: retain complete PCM during recording; transient transport failure recovers with the same source and the credential generation returned by dictationStart; missing or replaced account generations terminate before uploading retained audio

retiredSourceOffer: custom remains a valid saved value and a compatibility file-transcription route; the settings menu and the preference choice list no longer offer it, and a saved custom selection stays listed until replaced

uploadContainers.encoder: platform WebCodecs AudioEncoder; no bundled codec dependency
uploadContainers.fallback: encoder unavailability, encode failure or provider format rejection degrades the session to WAV; the final pass retries once with WAV

fileTranscription.capture: acknowledged audio worklet frames, 16 kHz mono PCM16, 100 ms per frame
fileTranscription.ledger: frames retained in memory; the full-session audio materializes without a post-stop transcode
fileTranscription.segments: first request by 2 s; later silence-aware cuts between 1.5 s and 5 s; sequential single-flight file transcriptions
fileTranscription.partialAdmission: one partial per owner, never gates the full-audio pass, aborted when it is admitted, raw text without polish or history
fileTranscription.completion: the full-audio final pass is authoritative; recovery requires every interval including the tail and consumes host receipts once
fileTranscription.receiptRetention: at most 256 source-matched receipts per owner; retained through provider waits and removed on recovery consumption, cancellation, owner detach or count eviction
fileTranscription.downgrade: two consecutive partial failures or a provider limit code disable partials for the session

unavailableCapability: hidden unless explicitly selected; preserve saved selection and show recovery

runtimeAdmission.workbuddy: actual transcription capability and account readiness
runtimeAdmission.antigravity: actual transcription capability and account readiness
runtimeAdmission.trae: actual transcription capability and account readiness

captureConfig: checks only the selected account; full availability is requested by settings
authenticationErrors: Signed-out and expired credentials retain the selected source and expose account recovery.
